thread:
Maria P: thinking out loud — what if we frame the next webinar as a 'Keystone: Inference Duel' instead of a straight talk? short live benchmark duel (two models/configs), one customer vignette, then a quick ops + routing playbook. keeps it high-energy and demo-forward. :zap:
Jon H: love the duel idea. helps surface cost/latency tradeoffs live. who do we have for speaker slots? need 1 product + 1 eng + 1 customer ideally.
Anya M: abstract sketch for marketing: 'Keystone: Live inference face-off — how to pick a model & serve it at scale' 3 bullets: real-world latency/cost comparison, routing + fallback patterns, customer case study. short CTA for a playbook download.
Kevin L: run-of-show draft (thinking 45m total):
```
00:00 - 05:00 Intro & framing (host)
05:00 - 25:00 Live duel: model A vs model B (eng leads) + live metrics dashboard
25:00 - 35:00 Customer vignette: short demo & lessons learned
35:00 - 40:00 Ops deep-dive: routing, canaries, cost controls (prod lead)
40:00 - 45:00 Q&A + CTA
```
Sam R: tight — can we compress duel to 15m and keep more Q time? attendees love Q. also we need a fallback script if live infra hiccups.
Maria P: good call. compress duel to 15m (05:00-20:00) then 20m customer + ops + QA. updated timings in code block on next message.
Jon H: speaker candidates: Nina (serving runtime), Omar (Prod Eng), Cloudinary contact (customer) — Omar can run the live bench. Nina can do the kernel/quant bits.
Anya M: outreach plan: CTA for "Keystone playbook" landing page + 2 LinkedIn posts (hero stat + screenshot of dashboard). ask speakers for 2 bullets each for one-pager.
Kevin L: fallback plan (short): if live bench fails, switch to recorded run (we pre-record a 6m clip of the duel) and cue it at 05:00. host runs through annotated screenshots while clip plays. prep checklist:
- pre-record duel clip
- final run rehearsal (with host) at T-48h
- backup browser + alt region test
- engineer oncall for live bench (assign Omar)

Maria P: rehearsal plan: 30m dry-run 2 days before, 15m tech check 1h before. call times: rehearsal Wed 10am PT, tech check Fri 8:30am PT, event Mon 9am PT.
deploy-bot: Reminder: create calendar invites for rehearsal + tech check — set reminders 24h and 1h before.
Sam R: content ask to speakers: 2 slides max for duel, 1 slide customer, 1 ops slide. also record short 30s speaker intros for promo.
Anya M: promo cadence: week -3 announce + hero stat, week -2 deep-dive thread + speaker blurbs, week -1 final reminder + register CTA, day-of short post + recording follow-up. target CPL goal: < $60 via LinkedIn + community channels.
Jon H: production note: live metrics dashboard -> expose three metrics only (p99 latency, median cost/perk, tokens/sec). keep it simple for audience.
Maria P: action items: Anya to draft landing + LI copy (due Thu), Jon to coordinate speakers + get pre-record (due Fri), Kevin to schedule rehearsals and confirm infra (due Fri), Sam to prep host script and slides (due Fri).
Anya M: noted. I'll also draft 3 headline variants for the hero stat: "Inference duel: 2x faster at 1/3 the cost?", "Benchmarking for production: tradeoffs that matter", "Ship predictable LLM features — a practical face-off" — will post for team vote.
Maria P: perfect. if everyone OK with dates, i'll lock calendar and kick outreach. :thumbsup:
Kevin L: 👍 locking those slots now. I'll also upload a short runbook to the shared drive with fallback commands and the pre-record clip link.
Sam R: thanks — feel good about this format. high-energy and useful.
Maria P: end of thread — next steps in action items above.
